identity_sources.observation: New Jersey's official facility registry lists Aspen Hills Healthcare Center at 600 Pemberton Brown Mills Rd, Pemberton, NJ 08068, with licensed owner Aspen Hills Healthcare Center, LLC.
The current first-party site names Aspen Hills Healthcare Center and describes the Pemberton skilled-nursing and rehabilitative-care campus.
The New Jersey Collaborating Center for Nursing independently matches the facility name, address, 204-bed campus and website.

browser_observation: Bounded requests to the first-party root and disclosures page returned HTML 200; /cms-hpt.txt, /.well-known/cms-hpt.txt, /price-transparency and /standard-charges returned 404. The accessible site describes long-term/skilled nursing rather than a psychiatric hospital, so CMS scope/type remains unresolved and no MRF was promoted.
interpretation: Facility name and address are corroborated, but the current publisher description and New Jersey license classify the campus as long-term care while the tracker roster classifies CCN 314023 as psychiatric. This is a supported scope uncertainty, not a closure or compliance conclusion.
next_action: Reconcile the CMS enrollment/type record and any successor or co-located psychiatric entity; obtain a facility-specific CMS pointer/MRF before changing the tracker finding.
